subject: Meg
text: The real Meg among the clones can be identified because she spins around after cloning herself.

evidence.quote: The real one is pretty obvious, she spins around after cloning herself.

subject: Moblin
text: A Hookshot shot to the back will instantly kill a Moblin.

evidence.quote: A Hookshot to the back will kill them instantly.

subject: Moblin
text: The club-wielding Moblin must be slashed three times before he clubs Link.

evidence.quote: The last Moblin has a club and must be slashed three times before he clubs you.

subject: Parasitic Tentacle
text: Parasitic Tentacles in Jabu-Jabu's Belly can be killed by Z-targeting them and using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Just simply Z-target it and use the Boomerang to kill it. These are only found in Jabu- Jabu's Belly.

subject: Peahat
text: A Peahat's weak point is its root.

evidence.quote: Peahat's weak point is its root.

subject: Peahat Larva
text: Peahat Larvae are killed when they hit Link's shield.

evidence.quote: (Yep, strangely they die if they hit your shield.)

subject: Poe
text: Drinking a bottled Poe soul causes Link to lose one heart of health.

evidence.quote: Don't drink it though, as you'll lose a heart from your health if you do.

subject: Poe Shop
text: As Adult Link, a Poe shop in the former guard's shack in Hyrule Market buys Poe souls.

evidence.quote: as Adult Link, there's a Poe shop where the guard's shack used to be in Hyrule Market. He buys Poe souls from you.

subject: ReDead
text: ReDeads can be stunned by playing the Sun's Song near them.

evidence.quote: It can also be stunned by playing the Sun's Song near it, making it easy to kill.

subject: Shell Blade
text: A Shell Blade's weakness is its heart, which is vulnerable to sword stabs or the Hookshot when opened.

evidence.quote: Its weakness is the heart, so wait for it to open up, then stab or use the Hookshot.

subject: Stalchild
text: Defeating a giant Stalchild on Hyrule Field awards a Red Rupee worth 20 normal Rupees.

evidence.quote: If enough are killed, a giant Stalchild will appear; killing him will give you a Red Rupee worth 20 normal ones.

subject: Tailpasaran
text: Tailpasaran are found inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly and can be killed with an Advanced Spin Slash.

evidence.quote: Killed with an Advanced Spin Slash, these rare creatures are only found inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

subject: Wolfos
text: If Link backs away from a Wolfos attack and it misses, jump slashing its exposed back will kill it instantly.

evidence.quote: If he doesn't hit you, he'll turn his back to you. Jump slash him quickly to kill him instantly.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Hitting Queen Gohma's eye with the Fairy Slingshot stuns her, allowing Link to slash her eye repeatedly.

evidence.quote: Hit the eye with the Fairy Slingshot to stun her, then get up to her eye and slash at the eye repeatedly.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Queen Gohma can be defeated in one sequence by stunning her with the Fairy Slingshot, jump slashing with a Deku Stick, and repeatedly pressing B while holding R to stab her to death.

evidence.quote: Stun her with the Fairy Slingshot, then jump slash with a Deku Stick to do a lot of damage. Afterwards, hold R while facing her(without locking on) and press B repeatedly to stab her to death. This method should only require one sequence.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: When Queen Gohma is on the ceiling laying eggs, shooting her red eye with the Fairy Slingshot causes her to fall to the ground.

evidence.quote: when she's at the ceiling laying eggs, shoot her in the eye while it's red with the Fairy Slingshot, and she'll fall to the ground, open for another attack.
